title: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths: card flavor text

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: Plane of giant monsters, crystals and bonded humans.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Bonder who chose to befriend a monster he was ordered to kill; betrayed Drannith in General Kudro's eyes.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: General of Drannith who enforces security and orders monsters struck down.

events.summary: Lukka looks from the parapet and sees beauty in a monster rather than a threat.
events.quote: Lukka looked out from the parapet and saw not a monster to be put down, but a fierce kind of beauty.

events.summary: General Kudro enacts security measures across Drannith after Lukka's betrayal.
events.quote: After what he viewed as Lukka's shocking betrayal, General Kudro enacted stringent security measures at every entry point into Drannith.

events.summary: Lukka is ordered to kill a threat but chooses to befriend it.
events.quote: Lukka was ordered to kill a threat. He chose to make a friend.

events.summary: Lukka's bond gives him his most powerful weapon.
events.quote: Lukka's bond provided not only friendship, but also the most powerful weapon in his arsenal.

events.summary: Narset struggles to meditate as dragonlings spiral around her.
events.quote: As Narset struggled to meditate, tiny dragonlings spiraled around her, conjuring thoughts of ancient clans.
